a. What is the value of a share of Summit Systems stock based on the original expected dividend growth of 6.3% per year?
The value of a share of Summit Systems stock is $
b. If you tried to sell your Summit Systems stock after reading this news, what price would you be likely to get? Why? (Select the best choice below.)

options.text: You would receive $28.62 because when you bought the stock, the dividend growth rate was still 6.3%.
You would receive $16.94 because markets are efficient and would incorporate the information about the new growth rate immediately.
You would receive $28.62 if you act very quickly because it takes a day or two for markets to incorporate the information about the new growth rate.
You would receive a price between $16.94 and $28.62 because you should get a blend of the old and new growth rate of dividends.
